scope: Development metric diagnostic. A future fresh causal panel is required before using this score as confirmed discovery evidence.
hypothesis: The static complete tensor failed because it measures possible writes without the task's live Left/Right gating. Exact weight contraction evaluated on A1-fit carrier inputs will rank MLP causal writing substantially better.
score: For each MLP, mean carrier-position L2 norm of read@Down@[(Left x_donor)*(Right x_donor) - (Left x_base)*(Right x_base)], using A1 fit only.

predictions.pred_a_exact_factor_replay_gauge_capabil: Exact algebra tests pass; all A1-fit rows are capable; four native captures cover 48 examples, 18 task/layer scores, and 16 unique development matches.
predictions.pred_b_conditioning_improves_both_mlp_co: Activation-conditioned Spearman exceeds the complete-static correlations for both tasks (0.30952381 has/had, -0.47619048 is/was).
predictions.pred_c_conditioning_repairs_both_ranking: Both correlations are positive and their median exceeds 0.40.
predictions.pred_d_zero_causal_fit_and_exact_price: No causal intervention, fitted scalar, backward pass, or update; exactly four forwards and 48 example evaluations.

decision: screen graduates the score to a fresh prospective causal test; null requires a path-aware or downstream-Jacobian-conditioned metric; invalid on replay, gauge, capability, coverage, matching, or price failure
